# Hunzala Saeed

> SEO, AEO & GEO Specialist, WordPress Developer & Video Editor based in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. 25+ client websites delivered and 25+ Google Business Profiles optimized for businesses in Canada, the UK, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan.

## Services
- SEO: Technical, on-page and local SEO that makes a website easy to crawl, easy to understand and worth ranking.
- AEO & GEO: Answer Engine and Generative Engine Optimization, so your brand is the answer in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Gemini.
- Local SEO & Google Business Profile: More calls, direction requests and walk-ins from people searching nearby. 25+ Google Business Profiles optimized so far.
- WordPress & Web Development: Fast, responsive websites built to convert, mostly on WordPress and Elementor, plus Shopify and custom builds.
- Video Editing & Motion: Scroll-stopping reels, YouTube videos, promo ads and motion graphics that make a brand look as good as it is.
